description: KT prompt ingress and governed commit guards.

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; exec python3 "$root/.kt-scaffold/hooks/prompt_ingress_guard.py" --client codex
hooks.commandWindows: $r = (Get-Location).Path; if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $c = git rev-parse --show-cdup 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $r = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $r ($c + '.'))).ProviderPath } }; $s = Join-Path $r '.kt-scaffold/hooks/prompt_ingress_guard.py'; $v = Join-Path $r '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; if (Test-Path $v) { & $v $s --client codex; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; foreach ($p in 'python3', 'python', 'py') { if (Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & $p -c pass 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $p $s --client codex; exit $LASTEXITCODE } } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Guvenlik denetimi baslatilamadi, cunku bu bilgisayarda calisan bir Python bulunamadi. Islem durduruldu. Python programini kurumun uygulama katalogundan kurun, proje klasorundeki Python ortamini (.venv) hazirlayin ve yeniden deneyin.'); exit 2
